source: Apple leaderboard mapping in scripts/scr_platform_services/scr_platform_services.gml; submit call sites audited in the GML project.

excluded.Current Daily Level Streak: Live/resetting streak state, not a stable all-time record.
excluded.Seasonal Endless Run: The source tracks season-scoped scores, but its reset schedule and cross-version semantics are not modeled as an Apple recurring leaderboard.

leaderboards.score_meaning: Elapsed time, sorted lowest-first. GML submits milliseconds and the Apple service boundary converts once to centiseconds (global.time * 100).
